SEARCH
Package com.saicone.types

Interface TypeParser<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type result of the function.
All Superinterfaces:
Function<Object,T>
All Known Subinterfaces:
AnnotatedTypeParser<T>, EnumParser<T>, NumberParser<T>, TemporalParser<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AllocParser, ArrayParser, BitSetParser, BooleanParser, ClassParser, CollectionParser, DurationParser, FileParser, ListParser, MapParser, PathParser, PatternAnnotatedParser, PatternParser, SetParser, TypeOf, UriParser, UrlParser, UuidParser
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface TypeParser<T> extends Function<Object,T>
Represents a function that parse any type of object and converts into value type.
